text:
[DarGlobal project] Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai | Dubai, UAE
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

Can foreign nationals buy Trump Golf Villas in Oman?

What are the tax advantages of buying property in Oman?
title: Trump Golf Villas

text:

What are the tax advantages of buying property in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses operating in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes. The Omani Rial is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability for international investors.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman is one of the safest countries in the world and ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Quality of Life Index by Numbeo in 2023. Oman aims to earn over $22.5 billion a year from tourism by 2040, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat, alongside the Saudi-Oman Highway, is significantly improving regional connectivity and driving investment.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
title: Marriott Residences

text:
[DarGlobal project] Marriott Residences | Aida, Oman
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
title: Marriott Residences

text:
[DarGlobal project] Marriott Residences | Aida, Oman
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
title: Marriott Residences

text:
[DarGlobal project] Marriott Residences | Aida, Oman
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

Dar Global and The Trump Organization Mark Successful Launch of $700M Qatar Destination to International Investors
19/11/2026
Palm Beach, Florida
Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, and The Trump Organization marked the official launch of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, at an exclusive event held in Palm Beach, Florida.
The event brought together international investors and distinguished guests to mark the introduction of the QAR 2.5 billion (approximately US$700 million) luxury destination, reinforcing the continued expansion of the Trump-branded real estate portfolio across key global markets.
title: Dar Global and The Trump Organization Mark Successful Launch of $700M Qatar Destination to International Investors

The event brought together international investors and distinguished guests to mark the introduction of the QAR 2.5 billion (approximately US$700 million) luxury destination, reinforcing the continued expansion of the Trump-branded real estate portfolio across key global markets.

[DarGlobal press release] Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion | 16 November 2026
Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
16/11/2026
Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).
The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion.

Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
26/10/2026
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.
Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.
title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate

text:
[DarGlobal press release] Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate | 26 October 2026
Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.
As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements.

[DarGlobal press release] Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest | 7 October 2026
Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
07/10/2026
Doha, Qatar
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October.
The limited release includes three- and five-bedroom Trump Villas, each offering the privacy of a gated community, along with elevated views of the expansive 18-hole golf course, Simaisma beach and the open sea.
Residences are now available to purchase, with prices starting from QAR 5 million. Works on site are expected to begin in early 2027, with completion targeted for the end of 2030.

[DarGlobal press release] Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln | 30 September 2026
Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
30/09/2026
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.

Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments.
Located on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, the landmark development continues to progress on schedule as construction advances into its next phase. The appointment reinforces Dar Global's commitment to partnering with leading regional contractors to deliver exceptional quality across every stage of development.

18/06/2026
Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC
The award marks a major milestone in the development of Rayana and reflects DarGlobal's continued progress in delivering one of Saudi Arabia's most prestigious residential destinations. The design-and-build contract covers the delivery of the primary infrastructure works supporting the Rayana community, including earthworks, roads, utility networks and access infrastructure across the development.

DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future
16/06/2026
Saudi Arabia
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities.
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations.
title: DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future

text:
[DarGlobal press release] DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future | 16 June 2026
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations.
The milestone follows a transformational year for the company. In FY2025, DarGlobal tripled its Gross Development Value from USD 7.5 billion in FY2024 to USD 23 billion, reflecting the scale and quality of the pipeline it has built across global markets, including five major master-planned communities and a growing portfolio of globally recognised branded residences. Revenue increased by 124% to USD 539 million, while EBITDA reached a record USD 126 million, reflecting strong operational performance and sustained demand across its international portfolio. Today, the company has approximately 6,100 units under construction across 16 projects and maintains a strong financial position, supported by USD 702 million in cash and cash equivalents as of December 2025, alongside a recently secured USD 250 million financing facility to support future growth.

DarGlobal (LSE: DAR), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, in partnership with Art District Real Estate Development, today announced the start of the collaboration to launch and develop MAD, Muscat Marine, Art & Digital District, a transformative new coastal destination that integrates oceanfront living, luxury hospitality, culture-led enterprise, and future-focused finance and digital industries. Beijing, Shenzhen
DarGlobal, the international luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange, has concluded a high-level strategic engagement in China, reinforcing its commitment to expanding cross-border investment partnerships as Saudi Arabia's real estate market opens to foreign non-resident investors.
The delegation held senior-level meetings across Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai with leading real estate developers, engineering groups, and contracting partners, focused on advancing collaboration aligned with the Kingdom's ongoing economic transformation.
